owner_model: off-ramp / on-ramp of diodic memory of recursion
proposed_bound: Reentry integrity; strict base revision, single successful merge per branch, child closes into private parent branch before root publishes, stale sibling is rejected pending explicit new excursion.
decisions: Operational test interpretation only. Strict compare-and-swap is a proposed policy, not a claim about canonical x,y,z meanings. No external effects executed.
test_model: function run(c){let head=0;const b=new Map(),ledger=[];const results=c.ops.map(op=>{const [verb,id,base,pp]=op.split(":");const n=Number(base);if(verb==="open"){if(b.has(id)||n!==head||(pp&&(!b.has(pp)||b.get(pp).closed)))return false;b.set(id,{base:n,parent:pp||null,closed:false,local:[]});return true;}const x=b.get(id);if(!x||x.closed||x.base!==n||[...b.values()].some(y=>y.parent===id&&!y.closed))return false;if(x.parent){const parent=b.get(x.parent);if(!parent||parent.closed)return false;parent.local.push(id);x.closed=true;return true;}if(n!==head)return false;x.closed=true;ledger.push({id,base:n,next:n+1,nested:x.local.slice()});head++;return true;});return {name:c.name,ops:c.ops,expected:c.expected,actual:results,pass:JSON.stringify(results)===JSON.stringify(c.expected),ledger,head};}
limitations: In-memory synthetic test, not a concurrent or durable database test.
Rejects stale siblings rather than automatically rebasing; retry/rebase semantics remain open.
Closed child is a local append, not a public commit until parent closes.
No inference about Meta Muse internal implementation or ancestry.
next_bound: Crash recovery between receiving a return and persisting the append; prove idempotent replay with durable transaction keys.
